caption: The video showcases a full-frame close-up of an iridescent surface, where vertical streaks and swirling eddies in magenta, yellow, cyan, green and violet over a pale grey-mauve base continuously deform. The central vertical bands undulate and stretch as their cyan and yellow cores waver side to side. On the right, a yellow-and-magenta swirl elongates, its internal bands reorganizing from a rounded hook into a more vertical, streaked shape. In the upper left, a magenta-violet swirl broadens and reshapes toward the right and down. The lower right gains more green and cyan, while the lower-left dark green band persists with a wiggling boundary. The changes appear as local stretching and hue shifts within the swirling bands. This slow morphing is already underway and continues throughout.
